name: Costa del Sol, Spain

visa.notes: Non-lucrative visa requires proof of sufficient funds (~€2,400/mo). Cannot work in Spain on this visa.

rent.notes: Idealista Q3 2026 (Sep 2026) asking rents: Malaga province 18.8 EUR/m2 (~1,504 for an 80 m2 2BR), Malaga city 16.5, Mijas 17.1, Estepona 21.1 (~1,688), Marbella 23.6 (~1,888). A pet-friendly 2-3BR of 80-100 m2 in Fuengirola/Mijas/Benalmadena sits around 1,600; Marbella and Estepona push toward the max.

sources.title: Malaga rents hit record high - Idealista Q3 2026 (The Olive Press, 2 Oct 2026)

groceries.notes: Couple grocery spend in Malaga 350-500 EUR/mo (WaypointSur model on Numbeo Aug 2026 data) plus roughly 60-90 EUR/mo of kibble for a 100 lb dog (modelled share, not separately sourced). Spain headline CPI was 4.9% y/y in Oct 2026 (INE flash), food rising but below last year's pace.

sources.title: Cost of Living in Malaga 2026 (WaypointSur, updated 31 Aug 2026)
INE - IPC adelantado octubre 2026

utilities.notes: Electricity for a 2-person home runs 50-60 EUR/mo nationally (about 270 kWh); Numbeo-based electricity+water for an 85 m2 Malaga flat is 138 EUR and the national 85 m2 basic-utilities figure is 133 EUR. Adds butane/propane for hot water and cooking, water, sewer and municipal trash (basura) fee; summer A/C in a house pushes toward the max. Internet excluded.

healthcare.notes: Non-EU resident retirees must carry full private cover (sin copago) for the visa and first year; Adeslas Plena Plus in Andalucia is 167 EUR/person/month at ages 60-64 (334 for two), with 61-70 quotes across insurers running 175-230 per person. Min is the public convenio especial after one year of residence: 60 EUR/person/month under 65 (157 at 65+), outpatient prescriptions not covered. Re-modelled from the old template where insurance carried health cover.

Mejores seguros de salud noviembre 2026 (Rankia)

insurance.notes: Renters/contents (seguro de hogar para inquilinos) only; health cover moved to healthcare per the old-template rule. Tenant policies run 70-300 EUR/yr nationally (Tuio from 79, Caser Inquilinamente from 110, Santalucia from 141 per year for a 71 m2 flat).

sources.title: Seguro para inquilinos: precios (Selectra, updated Jan 2025)

petCare.notes: Spain vet prices Apr 2026: consultation 30-60, annual vaccine pack 50-80, rabies 15-25, deworming 20-35/yr, dental cleaning 100-250; a healthy pet averages 200-400 EUR/yr. A 100 lb dog pays large-breed doses for flea/tick/heartworm and leishmania prevention (sandfly zone), so typical is set above the generic mid-point.

sources.title: Cuanto cuesta el veterinario - precios abril 2026 (CuantoMeCuesta)

petDaycare.notes: National 2026 guide: residencia canina 11-25 EUR/night (18-30 on holidays), guarderia de dia 9-20 EUR/day. Assumes 4-6 nights or days a month at the large-dog end of the range.

sources.title: Cuanto cuesta un cuidador de perros - precios 2026 (Cronoshare)

petGrooming.notes: Spain 2026 grooming guide: bath for a large long-haired dog 30-35 EUR, full arreglo 40-45, giant long-haired 42-51; de-matting 5-20 extra. A Bernese groomed every 6-8 weeks with an occasional brush-out averages about 40 EUR/mo.

sources.title: Cuanto cuesta un servicio de peluqueria canina - precios 2026 (Cronoshare)

transportation.notes: One modest car: average Spanish premium about 390 EUR/yr (CHECK24, May 2026), gasolina 95 about 1.53 EUR/L (Jul 2026) for ~800 km/mo, plus maintenance, ITV and road tax. EMT Malaga monthly bus card is 23.95 EUR (no over-60 card listed; Andalucia's tarjeta 65+ comes later). Min is a mostly car-free coastal-town setup with bus and Cercanias.

sources.title: CHECK24 - prima media del seguro de coche mayo 2026
Precio del combustible hoy 3 de julio 2026 (El Cronista)
Precios de billetes y abonos EMT Malaga 2026 (RedTransporte)

entertainment.notes: Fibre 300-600 Mbps about 24-30 EUR/mo (Lowi/Digi/O2 bundles with two mobile lines run 30-48), a couple of streaming services, mid-range dinner for two about 60 EUR three times a month, gym 25-50 and cinema 7-10 per ticket. WaypointSur puts Malaga dining+entertainment at 300-550 for a couple.

sources.title: Cost of Living in Malaga 2026 (WaypointSur)
Mejores tarifas baratas de fibra y movil 2026 (Xataka Movil, Aug 2026)

clothing.notes: Levi's 501-type jeans about 90 EUR in Malaga (Expatistan, Feb 2026, 7 data points); mid-market chains (Zara, Mango, Decathlon) keep a couple's replacement wardrobe near 80 EUR/mo. Stored range retained.

sources.title: Price of jeans in Malaga (Expatistan, Feb 2026)

personalCare.notes: Men's haircut about 18 EUR, toothpaste about 1.92, shampoo 2.50-4, shower gel 2-3.50 (Oct 2026). Two adults with monthly haircuts and toiletries land near 60 EUR.

sources.title: Prices in Spain (WageCentre, updated 4 Oct 2026)

phoneCell.notes: Two mobile-only lines (Nov 2026): Lowi 10 EUR for 2x15GB unlimited calls, MasMovil 9.80, Digi 16 EUR for unlimited data on both lines, Finetwork 20. Stored 79 EUR was a US-style figure; Spanish MVNO pricing is far lower.

sources.title: Mejores tarifas con dos lineas moviles - actualizado 1 nov 2026 (Roams)

taxes.notes: Estimated monthly income tax on $72,000/yr household income. Based on jurisdiction's effective retiree rate; excludes sales/VAT/property tax.

medicine.notes: Monthly prescription medication costs for household

medicalOOP.notes: Private GP visit 25-60 EUR, specialist 60-120, full blood panel 49-79 (Doctoralia/Top Doctors 2025-2026). With a no-copay private policy most visits are covered, so OOP is dental, physio, glasses and occasional self-pay specialists.

sources.title: Cuanto cuesta una consulta medica privada en Espana (Selectra)

healthcare.system: Spanish public healthcare (SAS in Andalusia) is excellent. Private insurance (Sanitas, Adeslas) widely available and affordable.
healthcare.waitTimes: Public: 2-8 weeks for specialists. Private: days to 2 weeks.
healthcare.prescriptionCoverage: Public covers most prescriptions with small co-pays; pensioners pay reduced rates

pros: Massive established British and international expat community

cons.text: Tourist-heavy areas can feel like enclaves
Safety & crime: see cited reports for current figures by city and country

taxes.notes: Spanish progressive income tax 19%-47%. Beckham Law may apply for new residents (flat 24% up to €600K). US-Spain tax treaty.
